data.body:
Implementation notes (narration kept off the description).

WHAT THE ORIGINAL PLAN GOT WRONG, and what the tree actually said:

1. It proposed one `merge_remote(tracker, remote_ref, *, git, message, dirty_strategy) -> MergeResult` fusing sync's and push_recovery's merge control flows. Reading both: sync unions, handles the unrelated-histories case, restores from HEAD, warns and keeps local; push_recovery sets the dirty tree aside as a stash COMMIT object, runs a bounded transport-retry loop, raises five distinct `_raise_if_strict` reason codes and returns tri-state. A single function parameterised over that is a worse module than two callers of one toolkit, so the approach was narrowed to the shared RECOVERY TOOLKIT.

2. It claimed both paths 'canonicalise' and 'recover local changes'. Neither is shared: `_lock.canonical_tracker` is called by `sync.reconverge` only, and `_restore_local_changes` exists only on the sync side (push_recovery uses stash-create/restore instead).

3. It listed `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py` in Scope. reads.py calls `sync.reconverge(...)`, whose signature is unchanged, so it needed no edit and was dropped from Scope and file_impact.

4. It missed a THIRD caller of the duplicated mover: `_commands/doctor.py::_quarantine_leftovers` imports `sync._quarantine_untracked` directly. That is why the untracked-fence convergence has a doctor-shaped blast radius, and why the sync adapter had to keep its exact name.

5. Acceptance criterion 'net change ... at least -150 non-test lines' is unachievable and contradicts this epic's own measured finding (the AC3 TRACKING comments on airborne-wellloved-kingfisher: eight consolidation children measured NET +241, because extraction relocates a body into one documented owner). Replaced with the uniqueness criteria the guard actually proves, plus a recorded measurement.

MEASUREMENT (AC4), `git diff --numstat` over non-test files:
  src/rebar/_store/merge_recovery.py  +162  -0   (new owner)
  src/rebar/_store/sync.py             +12  -106
  src/rebar/_store/push_recovery.py    +14  -34
  TOTAL add=188 del=140  NET = +48
Same shape as every prior child: both call sites shrink (-114 combined), the documented owner costs +162.

MUTATION EVIDENCE for the new tests (each mutation applied, the named test seen RED, then reverted):
  drop the '??' fence            -> refuses_a_tracked_path + syncs_door_now_carries_the_untracked_fence RED
  drop the common-dir guard      -> refuses_an_unresolvable_common_dir RED
  drop the existence fence       -> refuses_a_path_that_vanished RED
  shutil.move -> shutil.copy2    -> relocates_an_untracked_leftover RED
  parser trailer break->continue -> names_only_the_paths_under_its_own_marker RED
  parser absent-marker fence off -> answers_empty_when_its_marker_is_absent RED
  guard conjunction -> disjunction -> guard_needs_both_atoms RED
  guard escape reason optional   -> guard_escape_requires_a_reason RED (DID NOT RAISE)
  guard ignores escape marker    -> guard_escape_requires_a_reason RED
GUARD, proved on the REAL tree by injecting a second mover into push_recovery.py:
  unmarked copy -> FAIL ('quarantine movers outside _store/merge_recovery.py')
  '# quarantine-move-ok: legacy shim, audited 2026-08' -> PASS
  bare '# quarantine-move-ok:' -> FAIL ('carries no reason')
